title: wg: protocol-06 §7.5 UserRolePair.user is opaque, not IdentifierUri
description: Suggestion. §7.5 'opaque user<V>' while the prose calls it a user identifier and §5.2 defines IdentifierUri for exactly this. Implementations may compare raw bytes vs normalized URIs. mimid decodes opaque (decision mimid-1wgh.5.46). Fix: type it IdentifierUri.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: UserRolePair.user opaque; retype is no wire change; core is comparison rules. New issue, merge with 37.61(3).

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/159
